final_wiki.Q-9877 answer:
Q-9877: How many days are there from 2022-10-13 to 2023-01-22 (count the end date but not the start date)?

Answer: 101 days.

Calculation: Oct 14 through Oct 31 = 18 days, plus November = 30, December = 31, January 1 through 22 = 22. Total = 18 + 30 + 31 + 22 = 101.
